findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_pooling_draft · Private data: vergecommon_capabilities, list_public_coops, get_public_coop, prepare_pooling_draft · Public sink: list_public_coops.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_pooling_draft · Private data: vergecommon_capabilities, list_public_coops, get_public_coop, prepare_pooling_draft · Public sink: list_public_coops

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
